messages.subject: D-RUG & COVID-19
parts:
Dear All,

Davis R Users Group will be taking a hiatus for the next two weeks due to COVID-19. We encourage you to use the discourse site to ask questions and interact with our community during this time (d-rug.discourse.group). We hope to offer remote options soon (tutorials/presentations etc.), but need a little time to plan what D-RUG will look like amidst campus closure and COVID-19. We will send along a schedule as soon as we have one!

youRs from a safe social distance,
D-RUG Coordinators
